_comment: Country configuration (R-1). Source of truth for tools/build_geo.py and data/countries.js (generated by build_countries.py). One entry per country the atlas can open. 'regions' is either a merge table (admin-1 units folded into bigger regions, as the UK's 232 units -> 12 ITL1 regions) or 'units' (every admin-1 unit is a region, as US states).
